body:
## zpxwz's Health Indicator.
A simple yet elegant health indicator for clear status visualization.

### Features:
* Toggleable Health Indicator (F7)
* Configuration Menu (F8 / [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu))
* Self Nametag

The downloaded jar file should be placed in your mods folder.

![Normal hearts.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d2d4f46ecff93546064def12441fb5b800da859.png)
